datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data collected by FEWS NET enumerators through regular field assessments across Rwanda at monthly intervals during 2013. Geographic boundaries and IPC phase classifications were compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity severity across administrative units.
